photoEndpoints.alt: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on cushioned seating beside a coast. A blonde woman gently hugs a seated braided woman from behind while another woman leans forward to clasp her hand, and the fourth leans in at right. Their outfits include green-white-red-black minis, a white cropped top with a navy skirt, and a black-and-copper cropped mini outfit. Blue platforms, coral sandals, white knee-high boots, rainbow boots and arm tattoos vary across the group. Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real disaster.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women beside reeds and shallow-water reflections under a wooden shade shelter. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side hug while a seated woman touches their forearms and another leans toward her temple. They wear opaque emerald, ivory-and-navy, and green-white-red-black color-blocked mini outfits with covered midriffs. Pearl-trimmed reed patterns, agency and silent king arm tattoos, navy boots and rainbow knee-high boots appear in the diagonally framed scene.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women on cushioned wooden seating overlooking a green mountain valley. A braided woman in an emerald mini with copper leaf panels and a blonde woman in a quartered Panama flag mini share a side hug. The others lean toward them in an ivory green-vine mini and a cropped Panama flag outfit. Rainbow knee-high legwear with RAZE marks accompanies rainbow pumps and platforms, brown ankle boots and purple sandals. IA, GRD, star and scorpion arm tattoos are visible.

AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on cushioned wooden seating beside turquoise water and pastel houses. A blonde woman in a cropped Panama flag outfit hugs a seated braided woman in a turquoise beaded mini from behind. The seated woman clasps hands with a woman in a pearl cropped top and blue mini skirt, while a fourth leans in wearing another flag outfit. Rainbow legwear, varied boots and heels, and shell, heart-wave and RAZE tattoos appear. Distant smoke and mushroom-shaped clouds are invented scenery, not a real disaster.

caption: Kuwait ❤️ Panama: coastal hugs and wetland calm meet Boquete greens and Bocas blues. Rainbow legwear, back hugs and linked hands. AI fashion with imaginary smoke and cloud scenery, not real events. #WorldXXXSeries #InternalAgency
